stem: Control's own 95% interval for its conversion rate is 4.6% to 5.4%, and treatment's is 5.2% to 6.0%. The two intervals overlap. What follows?

options.text: Overlap alone does not settle it; build the interval for the difference itself
The difference is not significant at 5%, because the two intervals overlap
The two rates are equal, because both intervals contain the value 5.3%
Averaging the two intervals gives the interval for the difference between them
